physical.title: painting; album (detached folio)
physical.summary:
Selection of five miniatures depicting master and students; single-page paintings mounted on detached album folios. According to the text written in Persian nasta'liq script behind some of these paintings, they could be illustrations from a manuscript of the Tadhkirat al-Awliya (Biographies of the saints) by the Sufi poet Farid al-Din 'Attar (ca. 1145–1221) or the Rashahat cayn al-Hayat (Trickles from the source of life) by Kashifi Safi (1463–1532/3), a text dedicated to biographies of Sufis from the Naqshbandiyya order. The paintings feature various interactions between a master and his disciples. Judging by the architectural setting and the clothing of some of the students, the sessions are most probably taking place at court, where a shaykh was commonly appointed by the king to educate princes. Inscribed.
Ink and watercolour on painting.
